text: dsh-safe-download-files 是面向 DSH Web 客户端的文件下载工具，通过注册 download_files 模型工具接收公开 HTTP(S) 文件地址，并将文件保存到当前工作区的相对目录。它支持批量下载、并发处理、内容类型识别、文件名规范化和逐项结果反馈，适合需要把网页或远程资源作为本地工作区文件使用的场景。使用时提供 URL 与可选文件名，无需配置 API 密钥。

dsh-safe-download-files adds a DSH web tool for downloading public HTTP(S) files into a relative directory in the current workspace. Provide URLs and optional filenames; it processes batches, identifies content types, and reports saved paths or item errors. No API key is configured.
把公开链接里的文件下载到当前 DSH 工作区。
Download a file from a public URL into my DSH workspace.
dsh-safe-download-files 的功能「批量下载到工作区」：调用 download_files，传入一个或多个公开文件 URL 和可选目录、文件名；工具并发获取文件并返回成功数、保存路径、类型和失败信息。

dsh-safe-download-files README · Safe File Downloads for DeepSeek Harness：A DeepSeek Harness plugin that exposes one model tool:

```text
download_files({
  directory?: string,
  items: [{ url: string, file_name?: string }]
})

It safely downloads public files into the current DSH workspace. This is an unofficial community plugin.
section: Safe File Downloads for DeepSeek Harness

text:
dsh-safe-download-files README · Security：- HTTP(S) GET only, with no model-controlled headers, cookies, or credentials.
- Blocks localhost, private networks, metadata endpoints, and reserved IP ranges.
- Pins validated DNS results and revalidates every redirect.
- Detects the real file type and rejects mismatched or unknown content.
- Refuses executables, scripts, archives, Office files, HTML, SVG, and WebAssembly.
- Rejects absolute paths, parent traversal, unsafe names, and escaping symlinks.
- Writes temporary files first and publishes them atomically.
- Never overwrites an existing file.
dsh-safe-download-files README · Security：Accepted content includes raster images, PDF, UTF-8 text/Markdown/CSV/JSON/XML, and common audio/video formats.

dsh-safe-download-files README · Install：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add "git+https://github.com/Apoze/dsh-safe-download-files.git#main"
```

This is a complete DSH bundle. Restart DSH after installation:

```sh
dsh --profile web --dump-config
dsh web
```

No manual Cordis entry is required.

dsh-safe-download-files README · Limits：| Limit | Value |
| --- | ---: |
| Files per call | 100 |
| Concurrent downloads | 8 |
| File size | 25 MB |
| Total call size | 250 MB |
| Redirects | 5 |
| Timeout per file | 30 seconds |
| Tool timeout | 420 seconds |

Successful files are kept when another item in the same batch fails.

dsh-safe-download-files README · Test：```sh
pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
pnpm test
```

The test suite covers SSRF, DNS pinning, redirect validation, MIME mismatch, path traversal, collisions, cancellation, size limits, and partial failures.

dsh-safe-download-files README · HTTP transport maintenance：Version 0.1.1 uses the compiled Apoze dsh-safe-web-fetch 0.1.0-next.1 release (source commit 736e690cccd2d74126455633cd92fd252c35de08), pinned with a lockfile integrity hash. Its Undici 8.10.2 fixes the uncaught paused-parser EOF crash described in https://github.com/nodejs/undici/issues/5360. No runtime exception suppression or node_modules patching is used. Existing DNS pinning, private-address rejection, cancellation and size limits remain in force.

dsh-safe-download-files README · Compatibilité DSH 0.2.0-rc.1：Cette version cible les contrats V4 de DSH et Cordis 4.0.4. L’installation locale utilise le fork natif NInfer basé sur le tag officiel `dsh-v0.2.0-rc.1`. Les anciens plugins de récupération finale ne doivent pas être activés en parallèle avec `dsh-generation-recovery`.

dsh-safe-download-files README · Compatibilité DSH 0.2.0-rc.1：Pour développer contre le fork natif : installer les dépendances, puis exécuter `DSH_NATIVE_ROOT=/chemin/du/fork node scripts/link-native-core.mjs` avant la compilation. Les liens restent locaux dans `node_modules` ; les manifests et fichiers de verrouillage restent portables.

dsh-safe-download-files README · DSH 0.2.1 compatibility：This version targets DSH `0.2.2-rc.1`; the manifest declares this tested runtime through `engines.dsh`. Earlier plugin versions remain available in Git history for DSH `0.2.0-rc.1`.

The removed DSH runtime-invariant package is no longer a direct dependency. Public-URL validation and download protections remain enabled.
